title: Data Science Trainer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Shorat Innovations Pvt Ltd is a technology company delivering services across software, mobile app, and web development, as well as social media marketing and graphic design. The company focuses on empowering businesses with innovative, growth\-oriented digital solutions. In addition to services, Shorat Innovations runs corporate training programs in Java Full Stack, Python Full Stack, Data Science, Android Development, and Flutter Development. Its expert trainers provide high\-quality workshops and internships that support career advancement for students and professionals in the tech sector. The organization values excellence, creativity, and customer satisfaction, positioning itself as a trusted partner for technology and training needs.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Data Science Trainer will design and deliver data science training programs, including lectures, practical labs, and project\-based learning for students and professionals. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include creating and updating curricula, preparing lesson plans and teaching materials, conducting interactive classroom sessions, and evaluating learner performance through assignments and assessments. The trainer will mentor participants on core data science concepts, tools, and best practices, and provide guidance on career paths and industry trends. Collaboration with the training team to improve course content, coordinate workshops, and support internships is expected. This is a full\-time, on\-site role located in Tadawale Sammat Wagholi.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Science Education, with the ability to relate data science concepts to real\-world scientific and technological applications.
* Solid understanding of Physics and Mathematics to explain statistical methods, algorithms, and analytical models clearly.
* Experience as a Qualified Teacher or trainer, with demonstrated skills in classroom management and learner engagement.
* Proficiency in Lesson Planning, curriculum development, and creation of structured, outcome\-focused training materials.
* Working knowledge of core data science tools and methodologies (e.g., Python or R, data analysis, machine learning basics).
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex topics in an accessible manner.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related disciplines.
* Prior experience delivering technical or data science training, workshops, or academic courses is highly beneficial.
